mapper.select: select a.app_id, a.app_name, a.enabled, (select count(distinct am.user_id) from application_members am where am.app_id = a.app_id and am.deleted_at is null and (#{globalScope} = true or exists ( select 1 from system_admin_team_members team where team.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and team.member_user_id = am.user_id and team.deleted_at is null ))) as current_member_count, (select count(distinct pw.user_id) from personal_workspaces pw where pw.app_id = a.app_id and (#{globalScope} = true or exists ( select 1 from system_admin_team_members team where team.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and team.member_user_id = pw.user_id and team.deleted_at is null )) and not exists ( select 1 from application_members current_member where current_member.app_id = a.app_id and current_member.user_id = pw.user_id and current_member.deleted_at is null )) as historical_member_count from applications a where exists ( select 1 from application_members am where am.app_id = a.app_id and am.deleted_at is null and (#{globalScope} = true or exists ( select 1 from system_admin_team_members team where team.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and team.member_user_id = am.user_id and team.deleted_at is null )) ) or exists ( select 1 from personal_workspaces pw where pw.app_id = a.app_id and (#{globalScope} = true or exists ( select 1 from system_admin_team_members team where team.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and team.member_user_id = pw.user_id and team.deleted_at is null )) ) order by a.app_name, a.app_id

select v.version_id, v.application_workspace_id, v.app_id, v.repository_id, v.version, v.branch, v.repo_root_path, v.workspace_root_path, v.runtime_workspace_id, v.created_by_user_id, v.status, v.target_commit_hash, v.target_commit_updated_at, v.created_at, v.updated_at from application_workspace_versions v where v.application_workspace_id = #{applicationWorkspaceId} and ( exists ( select 1 from application_members am where am.app_id = v.app_id and am.deleted_at is null and (#{globalScope} = true or exists ( select 1 from system_admin_team_members team where team.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and team.member_user_id = am.user_id and team.deleted_at is null )) ) or exists ( select 1 from personal_workspaces pw where pw.app_workspace_version_id = v.version_id and (#{globalScope} = true or exists ( select 1 from system_admin_team_members team where team.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and team.member_user_id = pw.user_id and team.deleted_at is null )) ) ) order by v.created_at desc, v.version_id

with scoped_contributors as ( select distinct am.user_id from application_workspace_versions v join application_members am on am.app_id = v.app_id and am.deleted_at is null where v.version_id = #{versionId} and (#{globalScope} = true or exists ( select 1 from system_admin_team_members team where team.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and team.member_user_id = am.user_id and team.deleted_at is null )) union select distinct pw.user_id from personal_workspaces pw where pw.app_workspace_version_id = #{versionId} and (#{globalScope} = true or exists ( select 1 from system_admin_team_members team where team.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and team.member_user_id = pw.user_id and team.deleted_at is null )) ) select u.user_id, u.unified_auth_id, u.username, u.password_hash, u.organization, u.rd_department, u.department, u.status as user_status, u.created_at as user_created_at, u.updated_at as user_updated_at, case when exists ( select 1 from application_members am join application_workspace_versions v2 on v2.app_id = am.app_id where v2.version_id = #{versionId} and am.user_id = u.user_id and am.deleted_at is null ) then 'CURRENT' else 'HISTORICAL' end as membership_state, pw.personal_workspace_id, pw.app_workspace_version_id as version_id, pw.app_id, pw.application_workspace_id, pw.workspace_name, pw.branch, pw.repo_root_path, pw.workspace_root_path, pw.runtime_workspace_id, pw.base_commit, pw.status as workspace_status, pw.created_at as workspace_created_at, pw.updated_at as workspace_updated_at, w.linux_server_id from scoped_contributors contributors join users u on u.user_id = contributors.user_id left join personal_workspaces pw on pw.user_id = u.user_id and pw.app_workspace_version_id = #{versionId} left join workspaces w on w.workspace_id = pw.runtime_workspace_id order by u.username, u.user_id, pw.created_at, pw.personal_workspace_id

select u.user_id, u.unified_auth_id, u.username, u.password_hash, u.organization, u.rd_department, u.department, u.status as user_status, u.created_at as user_created_at, u.updated_at as user_updated_at, case when exists ( select 1 from application_members am where am.app_id = pw.app_id and am.user_id = u.user_id and am.deleted_at is null ) then 'CURRENT' else 'HISTORICAL' end as membership_state, pw.personal_workspace_id, pw.app_workspace_version_id as version_id, pw.app_id, pw.application_workspace_id, pw.workspace_name, pw.branch, pw.repo_root_path, pw.workspace_root_path, pw.runtime_workspace_id, pw.base_commit, pw.status as workspace_status, pw.created_at as workspace_created_at, pw.updated_at as workspace_updated_at, w.linux_server_id from personal_workspaces pw join users u on u.user_id = pw.user_id left join workspaces w on w.workspace_id = pw.runtime_workspace_id where pw.personal_workspace_id = #{personalWorkspaceId} and (#{globalScope} = true or exists ( select 1 from system_admin_team_members team where team.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and team.member_user_id = pw.user_id and team.deleted_at is null ))
